content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) Section 9.2 now recommends the use of insulin analogs or inhaled insulin instead of injectable human insulin for most adults with type 1 diabetes, as these options are associated with a reduced risk of hypoglycemia. Additionally, the guidelines now advocate for the early implementation of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) in adults with type 1 diabetes to improve glycemic management. Furthermore, the recommendations have been broadened to include the use of any glucose-lowering agents that offer additional benefits, such as aiding in weight management, improving cardiometabolic health, or providing renal protection.
